descriptionByLocale.it: Sales Assistant - Part time - Orio al Serio - Bergamo - Swatch Group Sales Assistant - Part time - Orio al Serio - Bergamo Azienda Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo stesso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti. Descrizione del posto DINAMICITA’, SFIDA, INNOVAZIONE, PASSIONE, sono parole nelle quali ti riconosci? Allora siamo noi il tuo futuro lavorativo! The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. ricerca nuovi talenti da inserire nei nostri negozi Corporate a marchio SWATCH di Orio al Serio come venditori part time contratto temporaneo. In qualità di sales assistant garantirai un’esperienza di vendita eccellente ai nostri clienti, dal punto di vista della cura e realizzazione dei desideri. Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. Parteciperai all’organizzazione del negozio assicurandoti che il punto vendita, il back office e lo stock siano sempre in ordine. Inoltre garantirai la corretta presentazione dell'immagine dei brand SWATCH e FLIK FLAK. Unisciti a NOI! Vieni a far parte del nostro Team! descriptionByLocale.en:
Store Manager Bilbao - Swatch Group Store Manager Bilbao The company Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries Job description SWATCH has an exciting opportunity for a Store Manager to join one of our stores in Bilbao. As a Store Manager your main tasks will be:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques. Profile The ideal candidate should be an experienced retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills. Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to Retail. The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus. Professional requirements Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Store needs. Availability for shift work. Intermediate level of informatics (Office). Languages Conversation level of English. Knowledge in other language would be a plus. Contact empleo@es.swatchgroup.com Job location CL GRAN VIA DON DIEGO L 31 1 48009 BILBAO (Vizcaya) Spain Company address The Swatch Group (España) S.A. Edificio C, Miniparc I Calle Yuca, 2 Urbanización El Soto de la Moraleja ES-28109 Alcobendas, Madrid Apply for this job Share this job offer

We are visionaries and revolutionaries – unwaveringly true to ourselves and unafraid to do things differently. • Job description Design and develop product learning content that simplifies movements, complications, materials, and craftsmanship for diverse retail audiences. Create storytelling‑driven learning modules that bring brand heritage, craftsmanship, and collection narratives to life. Develop customer excellence training programs focused on luxury behaviors, emotional intelligence, and elevated client interactions. Build coaching tools and learning resources to support store managers and trainers in reinforcing learning on the shop floor. Produce blended learning journeys combining digital, virtual, and in‑person formats for global deployment. Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Retail teams to ensure content accuracy, brand alignment, and operational relevance. Leverage learning analytics to measure impact, optimize content, and enhance learner engagement across markets.
• Profile Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 3 to 5 years minimum experience in learning design, retail training, or brand education (luxury, fashion or watches preferred). Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Suite & LMS Platform. OMEGA ist eine prestigeträchtige globale Marke, die seit mehr als 170 Jahren nach höchster Qualität, äußerster Präzision und immer neuen Innovationen strebt. IT Project Manager - Swatch Group IT Project Manager The company The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
• Job description You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, enterprise architects and external partners, you will ensure the successful delivery of approved projects, from initial demand through handover to operations, while contributing to program management and supporting change initiatives. Your main responsibilities include: Managing approved IT projects according to agreed budgets, timelines and scope. Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology. Preparing and maintaining project documentation, investment requests and decision materials. Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases. Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables. Communicating regularly with stakeholders, including business teams, management, PMO and related project teams. Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management. Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.
• Profile The ideal candidate brings: Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment. The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy. Solid understanding of business processes, logistics flows and project governance. The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication. A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset. The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment. A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, architects and external partners. Strong analytical abilities and the capacity to evaluate business demands and scope potential projects. Professional requirements Required skills and experience: 10+ years of experience in IT project management. Experience working in a large multinational corporation with international exposure. Expertise in IT project management, including planning, execution and stakeholder coordination. Strong understanding of business management and logistics processes. Good knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including cloud, networking and data center environments. Experience with SAP S/4HANA or modules such as SD/MM or FI/CO is an asset. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to model information flows and support change management activities. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent. Project management certifications (PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are considered an asset. Languages Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus. IT Project Manager
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. Job description
You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group.

• Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology.

• Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases.
• Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables.

• Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management.
• Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.

• Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment.
• The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy.

• The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication.
• A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment.

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville - Swatch Group OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville The company OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
• Job description We are seeking an experienced, luxury retail Boutique Manager to provide leadership in our prestigious boutique. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Luxury Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and exceeding goals, whist delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills.
• Profile Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals. Data Integration Engineer - Swatch Group Data Integration Engineer The company The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
• Job description You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets. Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape. Your main responsibilities include: Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries. Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components. Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs. Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes. Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware. Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows. Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile The ideal candidate brings: Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development. The ability to design and implement integration solutions across multiple systems and markets. Hands‑on experience with MS SQL, stored procedures, SSIS/ETL tools and related plugins. Familiarity with EAI/ESB technologies, ideally Software AG WebMethods or similar stacks. Experience with APIs, XML, SOAP and REST‑based integrations. Exposure to SAP integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs or ABAP debugging. A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset. The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team. Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders. Professional requirements Required skills and experience: +10 years of IT experience, including at least 2 years in designing and developing data integration or MDM solutions. At least 5 years of experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development. Expertise with MS SQL, stored procedures and relational database design. Strong experience with SSIS/ETL tools and plugins such as Theobald for SAP‑related integrations. Experience with WebMethods or other EAI/ESB platforms. Experience in Java/JEE development and object‑oriented programming. Experience developing web applications (AngularJS, WebMethods CAF UI or similar). Strong knowledge of XML, SOAP, REST and API‑based integrations. Experience with SAP integration technologies (IDoc, ALE, RFC, ABAP debugging) is an advantage. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent. Starting base salary range between 110k-140k/year (plus a yearly bonus potential) Languages Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus. descriptionByLocale.it: Hour Passion Fiumicino (The Swatch Group Italia) - Sales Assistant Full Time (Temporary) - Swatch Group Hour Passion Fiumicino (The Swatch Group Italia) - Sales Assistant Full Time (Temporary) Azienda Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo stesso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti. Hour Passion è un concept store di Swatch Group. Fin dall'inizio si è specializzato nella vendita di gioielli e orologi di marchi diversi. Grazie ad un portafoglio di marchi prestigiosi, Hour Passion ha attirato una clientela internazionale con un concetto di boutique qualitativo e innovativo. Situati in luoghi di prim'ordine, i suoi punti vendita contribuiscono a rafforzare la diffusione dei marchi e consentono ai clienti di fare la piacevole esperienza dell’acquisto di un nuovo orologio usufruendo dell’eccellente servizio di un professionista competente. Descrizione del posto The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. ricerca nuovi talenti da inserire nella Boutique Hour Passion di Fiumicino come venditori Full time. In qualità di sales assistant garantirai un’esperienza di vendita eccellente ai nostri clienti, dal punto di vista della cura e realizzazione dei desideri. Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chef de Groupe Microtechnique - Swatch Group

Chef de Groupe Microtechnique
The company
Swatch Group est un acteur de premier plan de l’horlogerie mondiale. Ses marques horlogères bien connues couvrent toutes les gammes de prix et sont les ambassadrices des montres Swiss Made sur tous les marchés.
En tant que laboratoire de recherche central du groupe, Swatch Group R&D, division Asulab, a pour mission de développer des produits, sous-systèmes et composants horlogers techniquement novateurs de même que les technologies de fabrication indispensables à leur production. Cet objectif est atteint grâce à des projets internes dans divers domaines techniques et la collaboration active avec des universités et des instituts de recherche externes.
Job description
Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Chef(fe) de Groupe – Microtechnique qui rejoindra une entreprise R&D multidisciplinaire afin de développer des composants, systèmes et
produits novateurs pour les entreprises du Swatch Group.
Tâches principales :
Responsabilité et gestion d’une petite équipe d’ingénieurs multidisciplinaires et d’horlogers
Supervision et promotion de projets innovants dans le domaine des montres et mouvements horlogers, mécaniques comme électroniques
Développement de concepts et technologies originaux permettant d’améliorer la précision et / ou l’autonomie des mouvements horlogers
Développement de systèmes de caractérisation et mesure
Planification et suivi de plusieurs projets, établissement de budgets annuels
Elaboration et suivi de projets en partenariat académique et industriel
Application de méthodes liées aux standards de qualité
Rédaction de rapports techniques et administratifs
Référence technique dans le domaine de l’horlogerie pour la Direction
Développement intellectuel, créativité et esprit d’innovation
Profile
Ingénieur EPF (ou équivalent) en microtechnique ou en physique, un doctorat est un plus
Esprit créatif, visionnaire et qui ne craint pas de se lancer dans l’inconnu
Intérêt marqué pour l’innovation et les technologies avancées
Expérience dans le domaine de la conception et la fabrication des montres électroniques et mécaniques
Expérience dans des projets académiques ou industriels multidisciplinaires
Curiosité technique et dévouement
Professional requirements
Compétences:
Excellentes connaissances dans la construction, la fabrication et le montage des mouvements horlogers électroniques et mécaniques
Bonnes connaissances en transducteurs et capteurs utilisant des couplages électromagnétiques, piézoélectriques, ou électrostatiques
Connaissances de base en électronique
Aisance dans l’interaction avec des scientifiques et technologues aux compétences diverses
Capacité à anticiper les besoins d’une équipe d’ingénieurs très qualifiés
Capacité à fédérer une équipe d’ingénieurs autour de projets techniques exigeants
Capacité à écouter, communiquer, collaborer et s’intégrer au sein d’une entreprise multidisciplinaire
Capacité à développer une vision globale dans le cadre de plusieurs projets
Capacité à communiquer vers l’extérieur (sociétés du Groupe Swatch ou externes)
Languages
Langues:
- Français : courant
- Anglais : courant
- Allemand : une bonne compréhension est un plus

2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
Suisse

L'azienda
Swatch Group è un giocatore leader nel mondo dell'orologeria. I suoi noti marchi di orologi coprono tutte le fasce di prezzo e sono gli ambasciatori di orologi Swiss Made su tutti i mercati.
In qualità di laboratorio di ricerca centrale del gruppo, Swatch Group R&D, divisione Asulab, è responsabile dello sviluppo di prodotti tecnicamente innovativi, sottosistemi e componenti di orologi e tecnologie di produzione essenziali per la loro produzione. Ciò si ottiene attraverso progetti interni in vari settori tecnici e attraverso una collaborazione attiva con università e istituti di ricerca esterni.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Head of Group – Microtechnique che si unirà a una società R&D multidisciplinare per sviluppare componenti, sistemi e
prodotti innovativi per le aziende del Gruppo Swatch.
Principali compiti:
Responsabilità e gestione di un piccolo team di ingegneri multidisciplinari e orologi
Supervisione e promozione di progetti innovativi nel campo degli orologi e dei movimenti orologi, meccanici ed elettronici
Sviluppo di concetti e tecnologie originali per migliorare la precisione e/o l'autonomia dei movimenti orologieri
Sviluppo di sistemi di caratterizzazione e misura
Pianificazione e monitoraggio di diversi progetti, preparazione dei bilanci annuali
Sviluppo e monitoraggio dei progetti di partenariato accademico e industriale
Applicazione dei metodi relativi agli standard di qualità
Preparazione di relazioni tecniche e amministrative
Riferimento tecnico nel settore dell'orologeria per la Direzione
Sviluppo intellettuale, creatività e innovazione

Ingegnere EPF (o equivalente) in microtecnica o fisica, un dottorato è più
Spirito creativo, visionario e non ha paura di entrare nell'ignoto
Forte interesse per l'innovazione e le tecnologie avanzate
Esperienza nella progettazione e produzione di orologi elettronici e meccanici
Esperienza in progetti accademici o industriali multidisciplinari
Curiosità tecnica e dedizione
Requisiti professionali

Ottima conoscenza nella costruzione, produzione e assemblaggio di movimenti di orologi elettronici e meccanici
Buona conoscenza dei trasduttori e dei sensori utilizzando accoppiamenti elettromagnetici, piezoelettrici o elettrostatici
Conoscenza di base in elettronica
Esperienza nell'interazione con scienziati e tecnologi con competenze diverse

Capacità di unire un team di ingegneri intorno a progetti tecnici esigenti

Head of Microtechnic Group - Swatch Group

Head of Microtechnic Group
The company
Swatch Group is a leading player in world watchmaking. Its well-known watch brands cover all price ranges and are the ambassadors of Swiss Made watches on all markets.
As the group's central research laboratory, Swatch Group R&D, Asulab division, is responsible for developing technically innovative products, subsystems and watch components as well as manufacturing technologies that are essential for their production. This is achieved through in-house projects in various technical areas and through active collaboration with universities and external research institutes.
Job description
We are looking for a Head of Group – Microtechnique who will join a multidisciplinary R&D company to develop components, systems and
innovative products for Swatch Group companies.
Main tasks:
Responsibility and management of a small team of multidisciplinary and clock engineers
Supervision and promotion of innovative projects in the field of watches and watch movements, mechanical and electronic
Development of original concepts and technologies to improve precision and/or autonomy of watch movements
Development of characterization systems and measurement
Planning and monitoring of several projects, preparation of annual budgets
Development and monitoring of academic and industrial partnership projects
Application of methods related to quality standards
Preparation of technical and administrative reports
Technical reference in the field of watchmaking for the Directorate
Intellectual development, creativity and innovation
Profile
EPF engineer (or equivalent) in microtechnics or physics, a PhD is a more
Creative spirit, visionary and not afraid to get into the unknown
Strong interest in innovation and advanced technologies
Experience in the design and manufacture of electronic and mechanical watches
Experience in multidisciplinary academic or industrial projects
Technical curiosity and dedication
Professional requirements
Competences:
Excellent knowledge in the construction, manufacture and assembly of electronic and mechanical watch movements
Good knowledge of transducers and sensors using electromagnetic, piezoelectric, or electrostatic couplings
Basic knowledge in electronics
Experience in interaction with scientists and technologists with diverse skills
Ability to anticipate the needs of a highly qualified engineering team
Ability to unite a team of engineers around demanding technical projects
Ability to listen, communicate, collaborate and integrate into a multidisciplinary enterprise
Ability to develop a global vision in several projects
Ability to communicate externally (Swatch Group or external companies)
Languages
Languages:
- French: current
- English: current
- German: a good understanding is a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America - Swatch Group

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
We are seeking an experienced, retail Store Manager to provide leadership in our store. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and delivering excellent customer service.
Profile
• Achieve goals through execution of our productivity program, team-member coaching and outstanding client service.
• Ensure a consistent and respectable store experience for our customers.
• Be able to think strategically and efficiently while running the store as per company standards.
• Possess the ability to prioritize, plan, delegate, and adapt to business needs at various times.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Ensure proper staffing of the store through recruitment and retention.
• Create and foster a nourishing environment for the team to strive and succeed.
• Develop and guide a large team of employees.
• Professional requirements
• 3-5 years of retail Store Management experience required for all candidates, specialty retail preferred
• Passion for the delivering the culture of the SWATCH Brand

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
L'azienda
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e conferisce loro la propria scintilla di creatività. Così, Swatch è considerato una tela su cui sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile taglio bordo, impostazione tendenza look e accenti tecnologia amichevole hanno tutti aggiunto allo stupore di possedere un Swatch.

Stiamo cercando un esperto, Retail Store Manager per fornire la leadership nel nostro negozio. Il candidato ideale deve essere un Retail Manager esperto con una forte attenzione alla guida delle vendite e alla fornitura di un servizio clienti eccellente.
Profilo
• Raggiungere gli obiettivi attraverso l'esecuzione del nostro programma di produttività, team-member coaching e servizio client eccezionale.
• Assicurare un'esperienza di negozio coerente e rispettabile per i nostri clienti.
• Essere in grado di pensare in modo strategico ed efficiente durante l'esecuzione del negozio secondo gli standard aziendali.
• Possedere la capacità di priorità, pianificare, delegare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in vari momenti.
• Massimizzare le tecniche di inventario, controllo dei contanti e prevenzione delle perdite.
• Assicurare il corretto personale del negozio attraverso il reclutamento e la ritenzione.
• Creare e promuovere un ambiente nutriente per il team di lottare e avere successo.
• Sviluppare e guidare una grande squadra di dipendenti.
• Requisiti professionali
• 3-5 anni di esperienza di gestione del negozio al dettaglio richiesto per tutti i candidati, specialità al dettaglio preferito
• Passione per la consegna della cultura del marchio SWATCH
• Eccellente capacità organizzative, comunicative e informatiche.
• Capacità di condurre e sostenere un negozio efficiente e coeso.
• Team-oriented
• Programma Vantaggi

• Entwickeln und führen Sie ein großes Team von Mitarbeitern.

Ainsi, Swatch est considéré comme une toile sur laquelle une myriade d'expressions ont été appliquées. Le style de pointe, les looks de réglage des tendances et les accents favorables à la technologie ont tous ajouté à l'étonnement de posséder un Swatch. Le candidat idéal doit être un directeur de détail chevronné avec un accent fort sur la conduite des ventes et la prestation d'un excellent service à la clientèle. Profil
• Atteindre des objectifs grâce à l'exécution de notre programme de productivité, à l'encadrement des membres de l'équipe et au service à la clientèle exceptionnel.
• Assurer une expérience de magasin cohérente et respectable pour nos clients.
• Être capable de penser stratégiquement et efficacement tout en gérant le magasin selon les normes de l'entreprise.

• Maximiser les techniques d'inventaire, de contrôle des liquidités et de prévention des pertes.
• Assurer un personnel adéquat du magasin grâce au recrutement et au maintien en poste.
• Créer et favoriser un environnement nourrissant pour que l'équipe s'efforce de réussir.
• Développer et guider une grande équipe d'employés.

• 3-5 ans d'expérience de gestion de magasin pour tous les candidats, spécialité de vente au détail

Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
• Job description En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente. Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle. Avantages : Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise Rabais d’entreprise Assurance vie Les responsabilités sont les suivantes: Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits. Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles. Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin. Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail. Conditions de travail: Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente. Statut d’Emploi: Temps Partiel: En moyenne 20 heures par semaine. Doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et peut être amené à travailler plus de 20 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
• Profile Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés. Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations. Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe. Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible. Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme. Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Professional requirements Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires. Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS). Job location Saint Catherine Street West 705 H3B 4G5 Montreal Quebec HB G (Quebec) Canada Company address The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd. 555, Richmond Street West Suite 1105 CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario Apply for this job Share this job offer

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’Emploi:
Temps Partiel: En moyenne 20 heures par semaine. Doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et peut être amené à travailler plus de 20 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Professional requirements
• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).

Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’Emploi:
Temps Partiel: En moyenne 20 heures par semaine. Doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et peut être amené à travailler plus de 20 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Professional requirements
• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).

Luxury Retail Keyholder - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Retail Keyholder with Longines, you will responsible for demonstrating outstanding customer service and leadership on the selling floor. You will help build and implement client outreach initiatives, build brand awareness, and assist in daily operations of the store. You will support and assist the management team in achieving all customer service and sales goals initiatives. You will also assist management in leading the team of associates to ensure operational tasks and procedures are successful as well as opening and closing routines are completed, all while keeping the customer at the forefront. You will represent and demonstrate the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
Duties and
• Responsibilities
Provide a unique and special experience to all clients
Reach & exceed your sales goals
Develop potential clients through both client outreach and networking efforts
Maintain and grow existing clients; keep records of milestones and client’s tastes and goals for future purchases
Assist team members in sales process as per established boutique protocols
Develop existing client base and reach new prospects through networking and outreach
Provide superior after-sale service to all clients
Provide the highest level of client service through personalized contact in product maintenance
Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
Team-oriented
Opening and closing the store as needed
Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience
• Requirements
Must have High School Diploma and/or equivalent
Must possess a strong luxury retail jewelry and time piece experience
All applicants should have 3-5 years of experience in a Keyholder position, specialty retail preferred
Driven to deliver superior service by exceeding customer expectations
Able to arrive to work on time and work late
Able to achieve sales goals and be goal oriented
Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
Must be able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
Clientele building skills
Must be able to demonstrate basic computer literacy
Flexible to retail working hours including availability on weekends and holidays.
Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
Bilingual is a plus
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Retail Keyholder to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 5 – 7 days per week. During peak sale periods will work for long periods throughout a 1 – 12 hour day. May be required to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

Portachiavi al dettaglio di lusso - Austin (TX)
La Società
Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie.
Descrizione del lavoro
Come portachiavi al dettaglio con Longines, sarete responsabili di dimostrare il servizio clienti eccezionale e la leadership sul piano di vendita. Aiuterai a costruire e implementare iniziative di customer outreach, costruire la consapevolezza del marchio e assistere nelle operazioni quotidiane del negozio. Sosterrai e assisterai il team di gestione nel raggiungimento di tutte le iniziative per il servizio clienti e gli obiettivi di vendita. Potrai anche assistere la gestione nella guida del team di associati per garantire compiti e procedure operative sono di successo, così come le routine di apertura e chiusura sono completati, il tutto mantenendo il cliente in prima linea. Tu rappresenterai e dimostrerai il marchio, dentro e fuori la boutique.
Profilo
Doveri e
• Responsabilità
Fornire un'esperienza unica e speciale a tutti i clienti
Raggiungere & superare i tuoi obiettivi di vendita
Sviluppare potenziali clienti attraverso l'accesso dei clienti e gli sforzi di networking
Mantenere e crescere clienti esistenti; tenere record di pietre miliari e gusti e obiettivi del cliente per gli acquisti futuri
Assisti i membri del team nel processo di vendita secondo i protocolli boutique stabiliti
Sviluppare la base client esistente e raggiungere nuove prospettive attraverso la rete e l'accesso
Fornire un servizio post-vendita superiore a tutti i clienti
Fornire il più alto livello di servizio client attraverso il contatto personalizzato nella manutenzione del prodotto
Utilizzare la conoscenza e la selezione dei prodotti per fornire un servizio eccezionale e costruire relazioni con i clienti
Gruppo orientato
Apertura e chiusura del negozio come necessario
Salutare i clienti in modo tempestivo, professionale e competente
Tutte le altre funzioni assegnate dalla Direzione
Requisiti
Istruzione e esperienza
• Requisiti
Deve avere diploma di scuola superiore e/o equivalente
Deve possedere un forte lusso vendita al dettaglio gioielli e l'esperienza di tempo pezzo
Tutti i candidati dovrebbero avere 3-5 anni di esperienza in una posizione Keyholder, specialità retail preferito
Guidati a fornire un servizio superiore superando le aspettative dei clienti
In grado di arrivare a lavorare in tempo e lavorare in ritardo
In grado di raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita ed essere orientato verso l'obiettivo
Eccellente capacità verbali e interpersonali
Essere un auto-avviamento e utilizzare il buon giudizio in tutte le situazioni
Deve essere in grado di lavorare bene come un giocatore di squadra in un ambiente veloce e energico
Deve essere in grado di sostenere il livello di professionalità; demeanor amichevole;
La capacità di lavorare bene con tutti i livelli di gestione interna e personale
Capacità di costruzione del cliente
Deve essere in grado di dimostrare l'alfabetizzazione del computer di base
Orario di lavoro flessibile al dettaglio, compresa la disponibilità nei fine settimana e nelle vacanze.
Capacità di multi-task e gestire priorità mutevoli
In grado di lavorare bene con minima supervisione; autostarter
bilingue è un plus
Questa è principalmente una posizione attiva, che richiede al Portachiavi al dettaglio di avere la capacità di stare circa 5 – 8 ore al giorno di solito 5 – 7 giorni alla settimana. Durante i periodi di vendita di picco lavorerà per lunghi periodi durante una giornata di 1 – 12 ore. Può essere richiesto di salire scala o salire / scale di decend per immagazzinare e / o acquistare merce in vendita. Richiesto per sollevare oggetti di peso 5 – 25 lbs regolarmente senza assistenza. In determinate circostanze, i pesi possono essere più alti. Richiesto per operare apparecchiature per computer, parlare, sentire, piegare, stoop, raggiungere, sollevare, e trasportare fino a 25 libbre. La destrezza del cervo è necessaria.

Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. As a Store Manager with Longines, you are responsible for driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientelling skills. You will manage, mentor, and develop a highly specialized sales team to the Company brand standard. You will own your brand at the store level. Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As an Assistant Store Manager with Longines, the position will responsible for assisting in directing the efforts of, and is responsible for, the results of the store and sales associates. This includes but is not limited to: accomplishing and exceeding store wide sales targets, providing support to Store Manager, assist in training; coaching of retail staff, retaining and building client relationships, as well as actively seek new client relationships. This person must be energetic and enthusiastic, be willing to engage customers with a sales-minded attitude, and display pride in our stores through strong work ethics, organizational skills and cleanliness. You will the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile

Performs daily activities of operating boutique as per company standards inclusive of maximizing inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.

Deliver sells results as per company goals.
Delegate and assign tasks to the sales team.
Assist in the development sales incentives and rewards within the store.
Ensures a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
Brings positive recognition to the brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude, professionalism and in-depth brand knowledge.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Train and lead employees to successful selling and customer service.
Partner with the Store Manager to ensure that proper channels of communication exist between the store and Corporate Office.
Help solve problems that affect the store's service, efficiency, and productivity.
Partnering with Store Manager on the responsibilities of the achievement of annual sales goals
Collaborate with the Store Manager on the coordination of the in-store activities, which include seasonal events, trunk shows, contests, and all involved tasks.
Adhere to and oversee compliance of established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, sales and record-keeping procedures, and overall maintenance of the store.
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements

• Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Business or equivalent preferred
Must have 3-5+ years’ retail store experience; leadership experience with sales and merchandise a plus
Good problem solving skills
Ability to provide outstanding customer service in line with Brand expectations
Excellent selling and customer service skills
Work independently and on weekends and outside of regular office hours
Fluency in English and other languages as required by location

The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff

Ability to deal with conflict and able to influence across functional lines

Dies umfasst, ist jedoch nicht beschränkt auf: Erledigung und Überschreitung von umfangreichen Verkaufszielen, Unterstützung für Store Manager, Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung; Coaching von Retail-Mitarbeitern, Halten und Aufbau von Kundenbeziehungen, sowie aktive Suche nach neuen Kundenbeziehungen. Diese Person muss energisch und enthusiastisch sein, bereit sein, Kunden mit einer verkaufsgefährdeten Einstellung zu beschäftigen und Stolz in unseren Läden durch starke Arbeitsethik, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Sauberkeit zu zeigen. Chef de magasin adjoint de luxe - Austin (TX)
La société
Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.
Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de distribution multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important dans les technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe essentielles pour l'horlogerie et d'autres industries.
Description de l'emploi
En tant que directeur adjoint du magasin chez Longines, le poste sera chargé d'aider à diriger les efforts et les résultats du magasin et des associés commerciaux. Il s'agit notamment : d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de vente à l'échelle du magasin, de fournir un soutien à Store Manager, d'aider à la formation; de coacher le personnel du commerce de détail, de maintenir et d'établir des relations avec la clientèle, ainsi que de rechercher activement de nouvelles relations avec la clientèle. Cette personne doit être énergique et enthousiaste, être disposée à engager les clients avec une attitude d'esprit de vente, et faire preuve de fierté dans nos magasins grâce à une éthique de travail forte, des compétences organisationnelles et la propreté. Vous serez la marque, à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la boutique.

Aider à la mise en oeuvre des stratégies et des plans visant à obtenir des résultats en matière de ventes par le biais d'activités clientèles, de services à la clientèle supérieurs, d'événements, de partenariats et de création de trafic.

The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Antwerpen - Swatch Group

Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Antwerpen
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Your mission
You will support the Store Manager in several tasks such as coaching, inspiring and motivating your team to achieve sales targets. As the brand's first ambassador, you will embody the Swatch/Flik-Flak values and guarantee the highest standards of welcome and customer experience.
Your responsibilities:
• Sales :
• Advice on and sale of products presented in the shop
• Interest in different brands and products
• Quality of welcome, service and merchandise presentation
• Customer acquisition and loyalty
• Appearance of shop and products displayed (windows, counters and furniture)
• Assisting other sales staff during sales (service, gift-wrapping, etc.)
• Contribute to the achievement of shop objectives
• Achievement of personal objectives (defined by Store Manager) and contribution to shop objectives
• Replacing the Store Manager :
• Administrative tasks, in the Store Manager's absence or at his request:
• Customer orders
• Control of deliveries
• Make sure there is enough material (bags, gift boxes, batteries, etc.)
• Communication with head office (parameter, E-Mail, telephone if there are special customer requests after agreement or if requested by the Store Manager)
• Manage the team in the Store Manager's absence or at his request:
• Integrate and train each new employee in the field
• Transmit to the team a passion for brand development, customer service and respect for Swatch values.
• Support staff in acquiring skills and reflexes in the field (selling skills, products, visual merchandising)
• Organize all shop tasks to optimize customer service
• Assist the manager in his or her mission to develop sales, supervise the team and run the shop.
• Lead individual time
• Listen to each member of staff (their confirmed successes and difficulties encountered) to develop individual and mutual confidence.
• Collaboration with the Store Manager:
• Transfer important information to Store Manager regarding daily business
• Keep Store Manager informed about employees
• Manage the store according to Store Manager directives
• Open communication with the Store Manager
• Carry out any other tasks requested by the Store Managerr, such as: inventory, restocking, new product information, monitoring attendance schedules, various administrative tasks, etc.
• Other tasks:
• Participation in events and training sessions
• Active participation in team meetings
• Cleaning and tidying the Store
• Compliance with rules and regulations (Dresscode, etc.)
• Reporting process:
• N + 1: Store Manager
• N + 2: Brand Manager
• Job type : Full time, permanent contract
• Salary: An attractive salary package including extra-legal benefits
• Hospital insurance
• Meal vouchers
• Ecocheques
• Mobility or bike travel reimbursements
• Working hours :
• Available on weekends
• Daytime work
• Evening work
• Work on public holidays
• Additional compensation :
• 13th month
• Commissions
• Profile
• Positive, enthusiastic and empathetic personality, with a strong team spirit;
• A natural leader with the ability to manage, motivate, coach and develop the skills of a team;
• Rigorous and organized, you are both interpersonal and business-oriented, and comfortable with numbers;
• Self-motivated and able to achieve sales targets in a dynamic environment;
• High attention to detail, flexibility and ability to handle multiple issues simultaneously.
• Continuous learning:
• Maintain and improve own knowledge of products and techniques,
• Participation in training sessions,
• Sharing knowledge and experience with colleagues.
• Professional requirements
• Generic skills applicable to all Swatch Group Benelux staff:
• Flexibility
• Customer-oriented

descriptionByLocale.en:
Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week - Swatch Group

Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week
The company
We are recruiting for a Part-Time 20-hour Sales Advisor for our White City Store!
The Swatch Group is an international group active in the manufacture
and sale of finished watches, jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group supplies nearly all components required for the watches sold
by its 17 watch and jewelry brands as well as by its two retail brands,
Tourbillon and Hour Passion. The Group’s production companies also supply
movements and components to third-party watchmakers. The Swatch
Group is also a key player in the manufacture and sale of electronic
systems used in watchmaking and other industries. With its watch brands, it
is also a leader in the field of sports event timing as official timekeeper and
data-handler of most of the Olympic Games of the last decades and major
international sports events. The Swatch Group has a unique emotional
culture. Beauty, sensuality, emotions in watches are as much part of it as
high-tech, quality and added value on the customer’s wrist. Both, emotional
poetry and innovation play an active part in the commitment to its
customers. The Swatch Group was founded in 1983, by Nicolas G. Hayek.
It grew out of the merger of two big Swiss watch groups, ASUAG and SSIH.
The Group has since shown steady growth in key financials, leading to
records. Today Swatch Group employs more than 33,500 people in over 50
countries.
Job description
Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a fast friendly service.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Swatch products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to guaranteed and after sales service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly sales targets.
• Oversee colleagues on the shop floor to ensure best practise is adhered to at all times, providing on the spot feedback when required
Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way
Reporting
• Accurate reporting of all administration and stock control.
• Collation of sales figures.
• Clearly articulate/communicate any issues the store has had in the absence of the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager
Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Delegate tasks to colleagues to ensure productivity during peak trade
Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Hold briefing sessions in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.
• Confident to communicate at all levels, within the Store and with the wider Swatch Group teams
• Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
• Be familiar with international customer’s customs and culture.
Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training programmes.
• Confidently deliver product knowledge and train colleagues on upcoming collections
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
• To undertake duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
• As a member of the store management team be prepared to act up in a more senior capacity when the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager are out of the business
• Assist the store management team to lead and inspire your colleagues.
• Ensure service standards and behaviours are in line with training and Swatch guidelines at all times
Profile
Essential
• Passionate to lead, motivate and engage a team
• Driven to improve conversion and ensure the store and team meet KPIs
• Enjoys developing team members, with the ability to provide constructive and positive feedback
• Passionate about providing the highest level of customer experience, leading by example for other team members
• Uses initiative to support the Store Manager and Assistant Manager in running the store and providing ideas for improvements
Preferred
• Previous experience in retail and/or fashion accessories
• Have experience dealing with international customers
• Ability to communicate in multiple languages
Previous Supervisory experience

The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.

Brand Executive - Swatch Group

Brand Executive
The company
About Rado
Rado is a globally recognized Swiss watchmaker known for its innovative design and pioneering use of materials. Since our beginnings in Lengnau, Switzerland in 1917, we’ve been driven by the belief: “If we can imagine it, we can make it.”
Celebrated as the Master of Materials, Rado revolutionized watchmaking with high-tech ceramic, ultralight ceramic, colourful ceramic, and Ceramos™ setting new standards in durability and design. Our collections have earned numerous international design awards, cementing our reputation as one of the most forward-thinking brands in the industry.
At Rado, we combine heritage with innovation, continuously exploring new materials, colours, and shapes to craft timepieces that are timeless, elegant, and enduring.
Join us and be part of a brand that doesn’t just keep time but redefines it!
Job description
What You'll Be Doing
Administrative & Operational Support
• Manage general enquiries from retailers and travel retail partners,
• Provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to the team.
• Prepare and submit regular reports to Rado HQ and the Service Division.
• Provide support for ad hoc projects.
• Administrative and sales support for new business initiatives and ecommerce platforms.
• Oversee all brand administrative matters.
CRM & Clienteling Support
• Review and clean customer database. Prepare the SMS/eDM flow of
the project
• Monitor, update, and analyse customer data on a regular basis.
• Support the Brand Manager in the development of clienteling and
CRM training materials.
• Create and maintain CRM tracking tools to monitor prospects and new
client follow-ups.
• Assist Marketing Manager in managing gifting initiatives for Focus
Clients, whenever needed.
• Assist in tracking campaign results for Focus Client initiatives,
whenever needed.
Sales Support
• Assist the Brand Manager whenever necessary.
• Maintain and update internal records, including new item creation and updates, pricing uploads, POS openings/closures, POS lists, and contract information.
• Liaise with Rado HQ on stock availability, pricing, trade descriptions,
delivery schedules, watch boxes, instruction manuals, and logistics planning.
• Manage staff purchase orders, staff sales, and stock transfers, including event support.
• Support regular assortment updates, including novelties tracking and shipping summaries.
• Assist the Retail Operations Manager in managing the Hour Passion assortment.
Retail Support
• Conduct stock checks for special customer requests.
• Create purchase orders in CBR for non-auto-replenishment models.
• Assist the Retail Operations Manager to be the assistant trainer for CBR system and providing support to the retail team.
Logistics Support
• Monitor weekly shipments from Rado HQ and coordinate stock
allocation to boutiques.
• Prepare updated stock lists and conduct regular target stock reviews.
• Follow up on back orders, inter-market stock transfers, and stock
returns with Rado HQ.
Marketing Support
• Implement POS visual merchandising materials and printed collaterals in accordance with brand VM guidelines.
• Liaise with HQ VM team and local vendors to ensure timely updates of visual displays.
• Update marketing budget tracking tools on a monthly basis.
• Coordinating with PR agencies to execute marketing activities.
• Assist in marketing campaigns by proposing and planning visual content for social media or advertising, and liaising with HQ to obtain approved assets in the required formats.
• Assist in coordinating with mall marketing team on promotional activities, including in-mall exposure and social media campaigns, whenever needed.
• Support the planning and execution of press and novelties events, covering VM setup, watch consignments, gifting, and logistics.
Customer Service Support
• Manage B2B and B2C customer service hotlines.
• Handle customer enquiries and cases.
• Liaise with customer service technicians and HQs’ technical teams to resolve complex cases.
• Monitor and track lead statuses with retail teams.
Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
• At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand, sales support, retail operations, or marketing coordination roles.
• Strong administrative, coordination, and reporting skills with high attention to detail.
• Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, Salesforce); ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, HQ, and retail partners.
• Well-organised, hands-on, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fastpaced environment.
• Proactive team player with a strong sense of responsibility and execution focus.

A Rado, uniamo il patrimonio all'innovazione, esplorando continuamente nuovi materiali, colori e forme per creare orologi senza tempo, eleganti e duraturi. Unisciti a noi e fai parte di un brand che non solo mantiene il tempo ma lo ridefinisce! Descrizione del lavoro Che cosa farai il supporto amministrativo e operativo

Marque Executive - Swatch Group Marque Executive La société A propos de Rado Rado est un horloger suisse reconnu mondialement pour son design innovant et son utilisation novatrice des matériaux. Depuis nos débuts à Lengnau, en Suisse en 1917, nous avons été poussés par la croyance: Si nous pouvons l'imaginer, nous pouvons le faire. Célébrée en tant que maître des matériaux, Rado a révolutionné l'horlogerie avec de la céramique high-tech, de la céramique ultra-légère, de la céramique colorée et de CeramosTM en fixant de nouveaux standards de durabilité et de design. Nos collections ont remporté de nombreux prix internationaux de design, cimentant notre réputation comme l'une des marques les plus avant-gardistes de l'industrie. Chez Rado, nous associons le patrimoine à l'innovation, explorant en permanence de nouveaux matériaux, couleurs et formes pour fabriquer des montres intemporelles, élégantes et durables. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie d'une marque qui ne garde pas le temps mais la redéfinit ! Description du travail Ce que vous ferez Soutien administratif et opérationnel
• Gérer les demandes de renseignements générales des détaillants et des partenaires de détail de voyages,
• Fournir un soutien opérationnel et administratif quotidien à l'équipe.
• Préparer et présenter régulièrement des rapports au siège de Rado et à la Division des services.
• Fournir un appui aux projets ad hoc.
• Appui administratif et commercial aux nouvelles initiatives commerciales et aux plateformes de commerce électronique.
• Surveiller toutes les questions administratives de marque. CRM & Clienteling Support
• Examen et base de données client propre. Préparer le flux SMS/eDM du projet
• Surveiller, mettre à jour et analyser régulièrement les données des clients.
• Soutenir le Brand Manager dans le développement de matériel de formation clienteling et CRM.
• Créer et maintenir des outils de suivi CRM pour surveiller les perspectives et les nouveaux suivis clients.
• Aider le directeur marketing à gérer les initiatives de cadeaux pour les clients Focus, au besoin.
• Aider à suivre les résultats de la campagne pour les initiatives Focus Client, au besoin. Soutien aux ventes
• Assistez le responsable de la marque chaque fois que nécessaire.
• Tenir et mettre à jour les dossiers internes, y compris la création et les mises à jour de nouveaux articles, les téléchargements de prix, les ouvertures/fermetures de POS, les listes de POS et les informations contractuelles.
• Assurer la liaison avec Rado HQ sur la disponibilité des stocks, les prix, les descriptions commerciales, les calendriers de livraison, les boîtes de montres, les manuels d'instruction et la planification logistique.
• Gérer les commandes du personnel, les ventes du personnel et les transferts d'actions, y compris l'aide aux événements.
• Soutenir les mises à jour régulières de l'assortiment, y compris le suivi des nouveautés et les résumés d'expédition.
• Aider le responsable des opérations de détail à gérer l'assortiment Hour Passion. Soutien au détail
• Effectuez des contrôles des stocks pour les demandes spéciales des clients.
• Créer des commandes en CBR pour les modèles non-auto-remboursement.
• Aider le responsable des opérations de vente au détail à être le formateur adjoint du système CBR et à fournir un soutien à l'équipe de vente au détail. Soutien logistique
• Surveiller les expéditions hebdomadaires du QG de Rado et coordonner l'allocation des stocks aux boutiques.
• Préparer des listes de stocks actualisées et effectuer régulièrement des examens des stocks cibles.
• Suivi des commandes, des transferts intermarchés et des retours d'actions avec Rado HQ. Soutien à la commercialisation
• Mettre en œuvre des matériaux de merchandising visuel POS et des garanties imprimées conformément aux lignes directrices de la marque VM.
• Assurer la liaison avec l'équipe de VM HQ et les fournisseurs locaux pour assurer des mises à jour rapides des affichages visuels.
• Mettre à jour chaque mois les outils de suivi du budget de marketing.
• Coordination avec les agences de relations publiques pour mener des activités de marketing.
• Aider aux campagnes de marketing en proposant et en planifiant des contenus visuels pour les médias sociaux ou la publicité, et en assurant la liaison avec le QG pour obtenir des actifs approuvés dans les formats requis.
• Aider à coordonner avec l'équipe de marketing des centres commerciaux les activités promotionnelles, y compris les campagnes d'exposition en général et les campagnes sur les médias sociaux, au besoin.
• Soutenir la planification et l'exécution d'événements de presse et de nouveautés, couvrant la configuration de VM, les envois de montres, le don et la logistique. Service à la clientèle
• Gérez les lignes téléphoniques B2B et B2C.
• Traiter les demandes et les dossiers des clients.
• Assurer la liaison avec les techniciens du service à la clientèle et les équipes techniques du QG pour résoudre les cas complexes.
• Surveiller et suivre les états de tête avec les équipes de vente au détail. Profil
• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, marketing ou une discipline connexe.
• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience pertinente dans les domaines de la marque, du soutien aux ventes, des opérations de vente au détail ou de la coordination du marketing.
• De solides compétences en matière d'administration, de coordination et de rapports, avec une grande attention aux détails.
• Compétence en systèmes MS Excel, PowerPoint et ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, Salesforce); capacité à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes rapidement.
• Bonne communication et compétences interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec les équipes internes, le QG et les partenaires de détail.
• Bien organisé, pratique et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches dans un environnement rapide.
• Joueur d'équipe proactif avec un fort sens des responsabilités et de l'exécution.
